title: Goa State Government Employee Health Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Healthcare support for eligible Goa government employees and specified dependants under state employee medical rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Goa government employees and covered family members under current service/health rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Goa State Government Employee Health Scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
